title: Symrise secures patent protection for SymSave® H technology in China
summary: — Strengthens protected multifunctional innovation in Symrise’s Care & Wellness portfolio — Granted by the China National Intellectual Property Administration (CNIPA) — Covers Hydroxyacetophenone–lipophilic compositions in aqueous formulations — Part of an international patent family spanning the US, Korea, Japan, Brazil, and India

extraction.key_fact: 심라이즈가 중국 국가지식산권국으로부터 자사의 기능성 원료 기술에 대한 특허를 취득했다.
